title: EPIC: Error PredIction and Correction for Power-Efficient Voltage Underscaling Multiply-Accumulate Unit
problem: Voltage underscaling enables power savings in MAC units but induces timing errors potentially causing catastrophic accuracy loss in compute-intensive workloads; error correction without high overhead is challenging.
motivation: Matrix multiplication dominates power consumption in DNNs; voltage underscaling offers significant power savings but requires robust error handling mechanisms.
method: EPIC predicts timing errors in underscaled MACs using a prediction bits searching algorithm that maximizes accuracy with low hardware cost, then samples correct output using a delay-tunable clock to correct errors before computational use; achieves up to 100% error correction while maintaining full accuracy.
key_novelty: Error prediction with delay-tunable clock correction achieving 100% accuracy under voltage underscaling (0.74x nominal voltage) with only 8% area and 1% power overhead.
contributions: Error prediction framework for voltage-underscaled MAC units
Prediction bits searching algorithm optimizing prediction accuracy vs hardware cost
Up to 52% power savings with 100% accuracy preservation; 60%-88% less area than SOTA error-resilient designs
limitations: Not discussed; focus is on error correction methodology.
primary_theme: Error prediction and correction for voltage-underscaled MAC units
